# Anne Shirley & Janet

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Janet](../character/janet.md) — confidantes who share personal stories · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gets a ride to her new boarding house with Mrs. Amelia [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is delivering the mail in place of her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories about her romantic choices, her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), and her cousin [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), before dropping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off at [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet's home, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

> In a letter to Philippa, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her new boarding situation at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes the charmingly peculiar home, her hostess's background, and the local characters including a taciturn hired boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also teases that she is observing another local elderly love affair, though she vows not to meddle this time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Janet](../character/janet.md) crying on her twentieth birthday over John Douglas's failure to propose despite courting her for twenty years. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show some spirit, [Janet](../character/janet.md) rejects John's offer to walk her home after prayer meeting. However, seeing John's stricken reaction, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) panics, chases him down, and restores the couple back together, leaving [Janet](../character/janet.md) right back where she started.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a blunt and unwanted marriage proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, [Alec](../character/alec.md) summons [Janet](../character/janet.md) to the Douglas home because old Mrs. Douglas is dying. Following her death, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and explains he was forced by his mother's deathbed vow to keep their agreement secret for nineteen years, leading [Janet](../character/janet.md) to forgive the late woman and accept his proposal.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last
